run: if getent group docker >/dev/null 2>&1; then usermod -aG docker atelier; fi
initScripts: mkdir -p /var/lib/docker; nohup dockerd --host=unix:///var/run/docker.sock --storage-driver=vfs > /.atelier/dockerd.log 2>&1 & for i in $(seq 1 60); do docker info >/dev/null 2>&1 && break; sleep 1; done; docker info >/dev/null 2>&1 || { tail -100 /.atelier/dockerd.log >&2 || true; exit 1; }
